achievements.title: IRC 2026 finalists
achievements.body: FISAT states that EIE students emerged as finalists at the International Rover Challenge (IRC) 2026.

achievements.title: Official DAWN campaign
achievements.body: The official rover site identifies DAWN as the team’s advanced Mars rover prototype.

achievements.title: Kerala finalist claim
achievements.body: The official rover site claims the team is one of only three teams from Kerala to qualify for the IRC 2026 Finals.

achievements.title: SDDR clearance claim
achievements.body: The official rover site states that the design cleared the System Design and Development Review (SDDR).
